# Generated Codex mirrors — do not edit

The `atlas-*` folders here are byte-for-byte copies of `.claude/skills/atlas-*`,
written by `python .claude/skills/atlas-content-editor/scripts/sync_bundle.py --write`.
Edit the originals in `.claude/skills/`, then run that command; CI fails when a
mirror differs. See `claude/atlas-skills-workflow.md` and CLAUDE.md §16.
